nodes.asset_description: Playful, flat, cartoon-style border illustrations on a transparent background: four diverse people reading placed in the corners (top-left: person in a pink scarf/sweater, navy pants, yellow socks, reading a yellow book; top-right: person in a green sweater with yellow squiggle pattern, lavender pants, brown shoes, reading an orange book; bottom-left: person in an orange/red hoodie, navy pants, teal socks, reading a pink book; bottom-right: person with long blond hair in a lavender sweater and orange pants, white shoes with flower detail, reading a pink book). Around the perimeter, a continuous pink wavy cord loops, connecting multiple scattered books: open and closed books in teal, blue, yellow, orange, and cream with visible pages; one closed book shows a moon-and-stars cover. Smaller stacks of books appear left-middle and right-middle. The center area is left clear for text.
